Claim: skills lane seat — graded and dispatched in one write (`priority:p3` + `pm:dispatched` + `domain:skills`), 2026-09-03T07:40Z. Triage is vacant in objectui and this is the lane's own programme follow-up (from the #7359 / PR #7427 flight), so the seat grades it, as it did #7359. Value gate (#13597): a tag that lies to every reader and every future gate, on a surface no gate reaches — passes as a truth item.
Session: `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`
Branch: `claude/issue-7462-jsonc-fence-tags`
Worktree: `/home/user/objectui-issue-7462`
Clause-②: no — fence tags carry no contract claim. Governed: `skills/objectui/**` ⇒ the PR stays DRAFT (ui#6866 批 #7); review requests are the seat's step.

Scope, exactly the card: re-count at claim (the 17 / 56 figure is from branch point `75e7436`); retag `json` → `jsonc` only where the block carries a `//` comment or a `...` elision (a fence that parses as JSON keeps `json`); no content edits; state the byte/token arithmetic (+1 byte per retagged fence); decide and say whether `scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` gains a `skills/` root (its declared-file baseline is shrink-only and must not grow — if widening would grow it, do not widen and say why). Gates: `node scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` (must stay green — the retagged fences remain unmarked), `node scripts/check-doc-fence-languages.mjs`, `node scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs`, `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs`, `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the final path list, plus the union objectstack's `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` derives (it answers "absent from this tree" for objectui paths — report that verbatim, then run objectui's own scripts by name).

Session: `session_01LraLgQVGq8egUwfYZpbYt1`
PR: #7473 (DRAFT, governed `skills/**`, no ready flip, no reviewers, no labels touched)
Branch: `claude/issue-7462-jsonc-fence-tags` · head sha `ec67429b2a984b27307b4d23345c9c094785e0d9` · branch point `0246d11`
Status: **done** — premise still valid, and re-measured rather than trusted.

## Re-count at the branch point

`skills/objectui/**/*.md` holds **56** fences tagged `json` and **0** tagged `jsonc`.
**17 fail `JSON.parse`** — the card's figure reproduced exactly, same per-file split:

| file | failing fence opener lines | count |
|---|---|---|
| `guides/schema-expressions.md` | 32, 170, 206, 328, 355, 365, 374, 391, 447, 463, 479, 492 | 12 |
| `rules/protocol.md` | 157, 166, 177, 187 | 4 |
| `rules/styling.md` | 170 | 1 |

## What landed

**16 retagged**, not 17 — the one judgement call that changes the edit, called out
below. Tag-only, applied by line number after asserting each opener is exactly the
six bytes of the `json` info string. `git diff -U0` filtered to changed lines is 16
removals of the `json` opener and 16 additions of the `jsonc` opener and nothing
else; 3 files, 16 insertions, 16 deletions.

| file | bytes before | after | delta | lines before | after |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `guides/schema-expressions.md` | 20653 | 20664 | +11 | 518 | 518 |
| `rules/protocol.md` | 13549 | 13553 | +4 | 320 | 320 |
| `rules/styling.md` | 10793 | 10794 | +1 | 319 | 319 |

+1 byte per fence, +16 total, zero line-count change. **Token ratchet: none exists**
in this repository over `skills/**` — the only two budget scripts,
`check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` and `render-budget-comment.mjs`, measure the shipped
JavaScript closure, not markdown. So the arithmetic is reported because the card
asked, not because anything gates on it.

Measured with the repository's own `parseJsonFence`: after the retag, 39 of the 40
remaining `json` fences parse strictly and 7 of the 16 `jsonc` fences parse under the
repo's JSONC dialect — 46 of 56, up from 39 of 56.

## Judgement calls

1. **The card's number and the card's criterion select different sets, and the gap is
   exactly one block.** "Carries a `//` comment or a `...` elision" (the claim
   comment's wording) selects **16**; "fails `JSON.parse`" selects **17**. The
   seventeenth is `guides/schema-expressions.md:206` — two top-level JSON documents
   listed in one fence, using **no JSONC feature at all**. I left it `json`, because
   `jsonc` would be a different false claim rather than a truer one: its defect is
   being a listing, not being a dialect. Every one of the 16 I did retag carries a
   `//` comment, so the elision criterion added nothing separately. If the seat reads
   the headline 17 as the scope instead, it is a one-byte follow-up on that line.
2. **`check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` does NOT gain a `skills/` root.** Measured, not
   argued, in two ablation legs (mutation proven on disk by marker count and blob
   hash before any verdict was read; restore proven byte-identical to the HEAD blob
   with an empty `git diff HEAD`):
   - widened, the gate **exits 1** on `guides/project-setup.md:115` — a `javascript`
     fence opening `export default` — which is UNKNOWN mode, and its header is
     explicit that UNKNOWN "can never be baselined and fails on sight". So this is
     stronger than the card's "would the baseline grow" test: the baseline could not
     take it at any size. Zero SYNONYM findings, one UNKNOWN.
   - the gate's scan surface is pinned element-by-element to
     `check-doc-snippet-types`'s by `scripts/__tests__/check-doc-fence-languages.test.ts`.
     Under the mutation the lists are 243 versus 227 and the assertion is false, the
     difference being exactly the 16 `skills/objectui` pages. Widening one gate is a
     three-gate surface move.
   - and `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs` already states, beside `UNGATED_DOCS`, that
     `skills/objectui/**` is deliberately unclaimed and that pointing a doc gate at it
     "is a decision for whoever owns that surface — never a side effect of a root
     move". The four-axis argument is in the PR body; long-term soundness leads it.
   - consequently **no self-test leg is owed** (no gate changed). The reverse
     verification that would have accompanied a widening was still run — it is what
     makes "do not widen" a measurement.
3. **The tag is load-bearing, proven both directions.** Throwaway probe on
   `rules/styling.md` under a trap: opt one retagged fence into `check-skill-examples`
   with the tag left `jsonc` and the gate exits **0** ("JSON phase: 40 fence(s)
   parsed, 0 failed"); flip that same fence back to `json` with the marker still
   there and it exits **1**, naming `skills/objectui/rules/styling.md:171 Expected
   double-quoted property name in JSON at position 50`. Restored, hash back to the
   HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
4. **No changeset**, by `check-changeset-presence`'s own verdict, quoted in the PR
   body. **No `needs:contract-review`**: a fence tag carries no contract or
   operator-semantics claim. **No labels touched at all**, per the seat's instruction.

## Gates

All re-run at the final commit `ec67429` with a clean tree; every exit code captured
by redirect before any pipe; verdict lines quoted in full in the PR body.

`check-skill-examples` **0** (after the build it needs — it exits 2, PRECONDITION NOT
MET, unbuilt, which is not a verdict) · `check-doc-fence-languages` **0** ·
`check-skills-paths` **0** · `check-shell-escape-residue` **0** · `check-control-bytes`
**0** (plus a direct control-range scan of the three changed files: no hits) ·
`check-doc-links` **0** · `check-changeset-presence` **0** ·
`check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the three final paths **3 = GOVERNED**, the
correct verdict · `vitest run` over 8 `scripts/__tests__` specs under the shared lock
**0** ("Test Files 8 passed (8) · Tests 347 passed (347)") · the `turbo run build`
closure the skill-examples gate names **0** ("Tasks: 29 successful, 29 total").
`eslint` over changed `.mjs`: nothing to run, the diff is three markdown files.

objectstack's `dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` exits **2**,
verbatim: "dispatch-gates: REFUSING — asked for 'objectstack-ai/objectui', but this
checkout is 'objectstack-ai/objectstack'." and "this script exists only in
'objectstack-ai/objectstack', so a sister repo's list is hand-derived from its own
package manifest and its own workflow files." The union above was therefore
hand-derived from this repo's `package.json` and `.github/workflows/`, none of which
carry a `paths` filter for these gates.

Not measured: remote CI (reported at draft time by dispatch contract; the merge-queue
leg of the governed guard cannot run on a draft at all), and whether a widened trio of
doc gates would pass over `skills/` — deliberately declined as out of scope.

## Out-of-scope findings — recorded here, not filed by me

1. **`guides/schema-expressions.md:206`** — a `json` fence holding two top-level JSON
   documents, no comment, no elision. No tag can make it honest; it needs a content
   edit (two fences, or one array).
2. **Nine more fences still parse under no dialect after the retag** — seven are the
   same multi-document listing shape (`schema-expressions.md` 32, 170, 447, 463, 479,
   492; `protocol.md` 177), two carry `...` elisions no JSON dialect accepts
   (`protocol.md` 157, 166). With item 1 that is eleven blocks. Content edits, one
   coherent follow-up card.
3. **Seven retagged fences are now opt-in-able** (`schema-expressions.md` 328, 355,
   365, 374, 391; `protocol.md` 187; `styling.md` 170) — adding the
   `check-skill-examples` marker above each would move the corpus from 39 to 46
   enforced JSON fences. Cheap coverage win, but a content edit, so out of this
   tag-only flight.
4. **`guides/project-setup.md:115`** — the single block that blocks any future
   decision to point a doc gate at `skills/`. It is a real JavaScript postcss config
   under a `javascript` fence, and it fails `check-doc-fence-languages` in the one
   mode that gate never baselines. Worth recording now, because it is the whole cost
   of that surface decision.
5. **Card-text discrepancy** (item 1 of the judgement calls): the card's Measured
   section says the 17 "contain `//` comments or `...` elisions", but one of the 17
   contains neither. Worth a correction if the count is ever re-derived from that
   sentence.

MCP GitHub calls this run: 6.

- **The widening question answered by measurement, accepted**: `check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` does NOT gain a `skills/` root — widened, it reds on `guides/project-setup.md:115` (a genuine `javascript` postcss config, UNKNOWN mode the gate never baselines) and its scan surface is pinned element-by-element to `check-doc-snippet-types`'s (243 vs 227 under the mutation); `check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`'s own `UNGATED_DOCS` note says pointing a doc gate at `skills/objectui/**` is the surface owner's decision. Long-term soundness leads: one surface decision, made once, by its owner. No self-test leg owed because no gate changed.
- **The tag is load-bearing, proven both ways** (marker + `jsonc` → `check-skill-examples` exit 0; marker + `json` → exit 1 naming `rules/styling.md:171`), with on-disk proof of each mutation and a hash-proved restore; the dev also recorded a perl no-op it caught by that same proof.
- **CI at `ec67429`, read 08:11Z**: every one of the 27 check runs success or skipped, including `Skill Example Check` (the gate that reads these files), `Doc Fence Language Check`, `Skill Guide Path Check`, `Shell Escape Residue Scan`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` (draft — correct), `Changeset Declaration`, `Doc Snippet Type Check` (completed 08:10:53Z), all four `Test` shards, `Lint`, `Type Check`.
- Follow-ups filed by the seat after dedup: **#7474** (the 11 blocks that parse under no dialect + the 7 retagged fences now eligible for the `os:check` marker — one content-edit flight). Recorded on the ledger, not carded: `guides/project-setup.md:115` is the whole cost of any future decision to point a doc gate at `skills/`.
- Governed `skills/objectui/**` ⇒ stays DRAFT; reviewers `os-zhuang` + `hotlong` requested at 08:12Z; human merge is the record. At MERGED the seat strips `pm:dispatched` (`Fixes` ⇒ the card closes).
